about: Everything kept so far from the spec's brainstorms, in one place, and from round 11 on the source. The world (round 13): a generic world by depth, with regions, transitions and themed areas set in it (round 12). 'parts' are round 8's places, each now inside one of these; 'fits' on places, monsters and strangers name parts. Fits of monsters and strangers are proposals, to be culled region by region. The game will load its content from data like this.

ladder.note: A monster's danger in rats: a lone rat is 1. A group counts for more than its sum (each one after the first adds 8%), unless it can only come at you one at a time (a narrow way), when it counts as its sum. 'Fair' is the biggest fight a character at that step should win. Twenty levels deep (round 21): shallow 1 to 7, middle 8 to 14, deep 15 to 20.

overDungeon.name: The Over Dungeon
overDungeon.line: The general dungeon between and around the regions: any monster, by depth. Its ground changes with depth: built rooms near the top, falling in, then caves, then something deeper still.

run.rule: Each run has at least five themed areas (regions, transitions and sub-regions together), with the Over Dungeon between them. Of the 5 regions, 2 or 3 appear. One is always the end game: at the bottom (levels 18 to 20), full, with its boss at its strongest. The others come on the way, full (at their range, with their boss) or small (higher up, a map or two, no boss).
run.endGame: The Dwarven Keep, the Deep Dark or the Drowned City.
run.filter: A region's monsters are filtered by the depth it's placed at: those whose danger fits the step (the ladder). A small region higher up gets the lesser of its kind.
